summary.headline: Lunar Astrology and Medical Practice
summary.text: Astrological-medical reasoning about lunar zodiac signs and bodily parts, including cautions against cutting with iron or administering purgatives when the Moon conjoins Jupiter. The passage explains moisture, inflammation, planetary temperaments, bodily humors, and diet as divinely given natural theory, with references to Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos and Glycas.
